en_US.title: Best Ending No Clean Hands
en_US.scanner: The best ending should not erase cost, uncertainty or complicity.
en_US.field_note: A strong ending lets the player save something real and lose something real.

en_US.external_site: Best Ending No Clean Hands defines the moral standard for final outcomes.
